title: Uploading A Custom Member Badge
content:
## Uploading A Custom Member Badge


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000073955

The " M ember Badge " is located on the member's dashboard. This badge uses a custom code that the member can then paste on their own website to advertise that they are a member of this directory website. This adds credibility to their own company, and helps promote the directory website at the same time.

This is how the default badge appears:


## Enable the Member Badge


The badge needs to be enabled for each plan, this is in Finance » Plan Settings » Member Dashboard .

Search for: Show Embeddable Member Badge Module

Set to " Yes ":


## Replace the Default Member Badge


To replace the default member badge please follow these instructions:

- Go to SETTINGS >> GENERAL SETTINGS >> BRAND IMAGES

- Click on "Replace Image" for the Member Badge:
